title: Fully narrated tour of Butchart Gardens and Saanich Peninsula
includes: Private tour of Butchart Gardens from Victoria
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Subject to favorable weather conditions. If canceled due to poor weather, an alternative date or full refund will be offered
The tour inside the gardens has an additional entrance fee and is self guided as required by Butchart Gardens management.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Visit one of the finest gardens in the world on this guided, 3-hour tour from Victoria, British Columbia. Walk among the fragrant displays and carefully recreated historical fountains while enjoying some of the best scenery the Saanich Peninsula has to offer. This fully narrated, small-group tour is fully customizable to private groups. Please note: admission to Butchart Gardens is not included.
